name: JWT & Base64 Decoder
blurb: decode a token and show its expiry and signature fields
intro: Splits a JWT into header, claims and signature (RFC 7519/7515), explains each registered claim, shows iat/nbf/exp as UTC dates and whether the token is valid at a check time, checks the signature length for its algorithm and, given a secret or public key, verifies it with WebCrypto in the page. Anything else is decoded as base64 or base64url into JSON, text or a hex dump.

inputs.label: Secret or public key
inputs.placeholder: HS*: the shared secret. RS/PS/ES/EdDSA: PEM public key or a JWK. Stays in this page.

examples.title: An HS256 access token, checked 30 min after issue with its secret
Plain base64 from a config file

usage: Give token (a JWT, optionally with 'Bearer ', or any base64/base64url string), mode (auto, jwt, base64), at (a check time as ISO UTC or Unix seconds; blank for none), and optionally key (HS secret, PEM public key or JWK) with keyEnc (text or base64). Returns the algorithm, expiry, status at the check time, audience, signature size and verification result; tables of header fields, claims (with dates) and signature; Header and Payload JSON. result.times holds iat/nbf/exp/check in Unix seconds. Base64 input returns its JSON, text and hex dump.
sources: RFC 7519 JSON Web Token (registered claims §4.1, NumericDate §2)
RFC 7515 JSON Web Signature (compact serialization) and RFC 7516 JWE
RFC 7518 JSON Web Algorithms (signature sizes, ES raw R||S §3.4) and RFC 8037 (EdDSA)
OWASP JSON Web Token Cheat Sheet (alg none, jku/x5u, lifetimes)
